title: Project Foundation & Configuration
description: Start by understanding the project structure and build configuration. This step covers the package metadata, Next.js configuration (including routing/redirects), TypeScript setup, and Tailwind CSS theme. These files establish the foundation for the entire application.

title: Environment & Type Definitions
description: Understand the TypeScript type system and development setup. This covers auto-generated type definitions, path aliases (@/* => ./src/*), and the Claude Code configuration for automation hooks. Essential for understanding how TypeScript and Next.js work together in this project.

title: Page Structure & Routing
description: Examine the main page layouts and routing structure. The root layout defines the global page structure. Giveaway quiz pages demonstrate dynamic routing for lead magnets and engagement.

title: API Endpoints & Request Handlers
description: Explore the backend API routes that power the application. This includes checkout sessions, event reminders, authentication flows, and lead magnet subscriptions. These endpoints handle user interactions like event registration and email subscriptions.

title: UI Components & Rendering
description: Understand the reusable React components that render the user interface. The EventPageView renders dynamic event sections (hero, checklist, video, CTA). EventRegistrationSection handles the checkout form with Stripe integration, promo codes, and confirmation modals.

title: Business Logic & Data Utilities
description: Dive into the core business logic libraries that power events, checkout, email, and subscriptions. These utilities handle pricing calculations, email template generation, Stripe integration, lead magnet processing, and calendar integration.

title: Integration & External Services
description: Understand how the application integrates with external services like Stripe, Google Calendar, and Resend email service. These modules provide guards, wrappers, and utilities for payment processing, calendar invitations, and email delivery.

title: Documentation & Developer Tools
description: Review the project documentation and Claude Code integration guidelines. These files help developers understand code intelligence tools (GitNexus), impact analysis, and project conventions for this workshop site.
